headline: Housing in Querétaro Appreciated 4.6% in Third Quarter
summary: Housing in Querétaro appreciated 4.6% in the July-September quarter, according to the SHF house price index. It is the smallest quarterly change in more than seven years.
why: Housing prices reflect credit conditions and household wealth, which matter for banks, mortgage lenders and construction investors.
original_headline: Vivienda en Querétaro se apreció 4.6% en el tercer trimestre
